title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Private Schools Regulatory Authority Amendment Act 2017

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Private Schools Regulatory Authority Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XXVII OF 2017
ACT XXVII OF 2017
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PRIVATE SCHOOLS
REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Private Schools Regulatory Authority Act, 2017
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Private Schools Regulatory
Authority Act, 2017 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXV of 2017) for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Private Schools Regulatory
Authority (Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Private Schools Regulatory Authority Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Amendment in Section 4 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No.XXV of 2017

ACT XXVII OF 2017
ACT XXVII OF 2017
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PRIVATE SCHOOLS
REGULATORY AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Private Schools Regulatory Authority Act, 2017
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Private Schools Regulatory
Authority Act, 2017 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXV of 2017) for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Amendment
in Section 4 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No.XXV of 2017.---(1) In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Private Schools
Regulatory Authority Act, 2017, subsection 1(a) of section 4, the expression
"Minister for Elementary and Secondary Education Department" shall be
substituted with the words "Secretary to Government, Elementary and
Secondary Education Department"
(2) In
subsection 1(b) of section 4, the expression "Secretary to Government,
Elementary and Secondary Education Department" shall be substituted with
the words "Special Secretary to Government, Elementary and Secondary
Education Department"
(3) In
subsection 2(a) of section 4, the words "nominated by the Government on
such terms and conditions as may be prescribed and shall hold office for a
period of three years and shall not be eligible for re-nomination" shall
be substituted with the words "elected and nominated respectively for the
fix term of three years in the manner and on the conditions as may be
prescribed".
